shelfmark: Gelders Archief (Arnhem), 0370 Heren en graven van Culemborg, inv. nr. 1257
how: All 856 scans as screenshots of the archieven.nl viewer (anl_view.js / anl_view2.js), read on contact sheets at 248 px a scan (330 px for scans 1-24); the cipher scans and their neighbours again at 500 px, scans 723 and 819 in part at full screenshot size. 84 screenshots with unloaded viewer tiles were taken again (white.py) and re-read. A scan shows one page with the edge of the facing page.
cipher_system: Two systems. (1) Scans 715-819: numbers 1 to about 23 (also 33) separated by dots, with German words in clear between the runs: a small numeric alphabet, used by the Elector and by Waldeck alike. (2) Scan 723 only: a code with numbers up to four digits (27, 118, 1789, 4379, 5252 ...) mixed with single letters and letter pairs (b, k, f, ll, D, T).

cipher_leaves.date: with the Elector's letter of 11 Aug 1655 (scan 713)
cipher_leaves.what: Slip pasted on the back of the letter: 3 lines of the small number cipher over the Elector's signature. Its text is the same as the last three lines of scan 717 (the slip shows through or is the foot of that leaf).
cipher_leaves.note: probably the foot of the leaf of scan 717, not a separate text

cipher_leaves.what: 'Postscriptum': about 16 lines wholly in the small number cipher, signed Friedrich Wilhelm. Scan 718 is its blank back (show-through).

Letter in a formal chancery hand; after the salutation about 17 lines in the large-number code (system 2). Continues on scan 724 (4 code lines, then clear text and signature, dated Cölln 17 Aug 1655).

cipher_leaves.parties: Waldeck → Elector (letter kept in the register, with marginal summaries in another hand)
cipher_leaves.what: Clear German letter; the last 3 lines of the page are number cipher with clear words.
Continuation: four cipher passages in the clear text, about 12 lines of numbers in all.
Continuation: 3 cipher lines at the head of the page, then clear. Ends on scan 790 (clear, signed).
Formal letter: 5 clear lines, then about 13 lines of number cipher with clear words.
Continuation: about 20 lines, nearly all numbers.
End of the letter: 15 lines nearly all numbers, closing formula and date in clear, signed. (The leaf the first pass saw.) Scan 796 is the address side.
'P.S.': about 22 lines, clear German words and number runs alternating.
End of the P.S.: 9 lines of numbers, signed; addressed at the foot to the Count of Waldeck.

cipher_leaves.parties: Waldeck → Elector (marginal summaries in another hand)
cipher_leaves.what: Clear letter with 3 cipher runs in the lower third (about 3 lines).
Continuation: one block of about 12 lines of numbers in the middle of the page; one clear line above it struck through. Ends on scan 815 (clear, signed).

Formal letter naming Prince Radziwill, the Lithuanian Grand Chancellor: 6 clear lines, then about 10 lines of number cipher. The number groups are underlined word by word and a later hand has written notes in the left margin beside them: possibly a contemporary summary or part decipherment. Not read.
cipher_leaves.note: check the margin before treating this leaf as undeciphered

not_cipher: Scans 1-712, 725-786, 799-812, 820-856: clear German (a few French and Latin pieces): the Elector's signed letters with seals, Waldeck's drafts and numbered memorials, muster and pay tables with sums (scans 187-215, 635-637), instructions, many blank leaves. Scans 718, 724 (lower part), 796 and 799 show cipher only as show-through or at the edge of the facing page.
result: Cipher on 14 scans, all between scan 715 and scan 819, all of 11 Aug - Sept 1655: six pieces. Elector to Waldeck: postscript of mid-August (717, with slip 715), letter of 17 Aug in a different, large-number code (723-724), letter of Cöslin 4 Sept (793-795) with its P.S. (797-798), letter of September on Radziwill (819). Waldeck to the Elector: letters of 7 Sept (787-789) and 14 Sept (813-814). About 170 lines of cipher. No interlinear decipherment on any leaf; scan 819 alone has underlining and marginal notes that need a closer look.
limits: Contact-sheet reading at 248 px a scan separates number cipher from cursive reliably where it fills a line; a single short number group inside a clear draft in the first 700 scans could have been missed. Line counts are estimates from 500 px images.
